capabilities: Arrange chapter and scene cards on custom colored lines (StoryLines view)
Group chapters and scenes by character, location or in-story date
Plan unwritten story rows in a Story Outline table and turn them into notes
Edit the Story Outline as an editable Plot matrix of cells
Recognize chapters and scenes from note titles and folder structure
disambiguation: Not a general graph or data visualization tool; it maps story chapters and scenes onto lines for fiction writers.
extras: Author accepts donations via Ko-fi; requires Obsidian 1.10.0 or later; chapter/scene title recognition ships in English and Spanish only.
problem: Obsidian treats a story only as a pile of notes, with no way to see its chapter and scene structure visually or plan unwritten scenes as future notes.

relations.evidence: they are designed to complement each other and work best together
